item.title: Regenerative Agroforestry Workshop hosted by Dharma Realm University
item.description: Dharma Realm Buddhist University is hosting the return of the co-founders of Mama Food Forest- a regenerative agriculture project located in Hawaii. A four-day agroforestry workshop will take place March 5-8.
